config.node_objective: Download the photos of the public Google Photos shared album at ALBUM_URL = https://photos.app.goo.gl/GjN5cVQbmtrdAUHJ7 into /workspace/download-album-photos/ and write a manifest. IMPORTANT BACKGROUND: this short link is JS-only - plain curl_cffi/requests on the short URL returns a bootstrap page WITHOUT image URLs. You must resolve the album in a real stealth browser first, then download each photo with curl_cffi. Steps: 1. Write and run a Python script that opens the album with a stealth browser (the image has camoufox/playwright): - from camoufox.sync_api import Camoufox - with Camoufox(headless=True) as browser: page = browser.new_page() - page.goto('https://photos.app.goo.gl/GjN5cVQbmtrdAUHJ7', timeout=90000) and wait for the resolved photos.google.com/share page (page.wait_for_url('**photos.google.com/share/**', timeout=60000) or wait_for_timeout then read page.url) - Scroll to load all thumbnails (e.g. loop page.mouse.wheel / page.keyboard press End a few times, or page.evaluate window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)) and wait a couple seconds between scrolls. - Extract image URLs from the DOM: collect all src/srcset and href pointing at https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/... (strip size suffixes like =w...-h...-k-no so you keep base URLs; prefer larger sizes, e.g. append =w2560). De-duplicate. - Save the list to /tmp/album_urls.json and print page.url + count. 2. If the browser hit a consent/captcha wall or no URLs were extracted after scrolling, retry once with a fresh page; if still blocked, STOP and report exactly what blocked you (do not fabricate URLs). 3. Download each URL with curl_cffi into the deliverables directory /workspace/download-album-photos/: name files photo_001.jpg, photo_002.jpg ... (match by content-type if needed). Use requests.get(url, impersonate='chrome', timeout=60) with allow_redirects. 4. Verify every downloaded file is non-empty and looks like an image (starts with the right magic bytes / content-type image/*). 5. Write /workspace/download-album-photos/manifest.json: {album_url, resolved_page, files: [{file, source_url, bytes}] , downloaded: N}. Rules: only report images actually downloaded and verified; if the album is empty or unreachable, say so explicitly; do not guess image URLs.
